title: decision: a mimid user's identifierQuery 'handle' is its mimi:// user URI
description: protocol-06 §5.8: 'handle means that the entire handle URI matches exactly (for example: im:alice.smith@a.example)'; the draft defers identifier formats to I-D.mahy-mimi-identity (TODO at the end of §5.8). Readings: (a) handle is a separate im: (or other) handle URI, which mimid users do not have, so no handle query could ever match; (b) a user's handle is its MIMI user URI (mimi://<provider>/u/<id>), the only stable identifier mimid has. Chosen: (b). Applies to inbound matching only.
